name: @buddhilw/plato
description: Data-driven ClojureScript presentation engine powered by Reveal.js and Desargues scene graphs.

scripts.dev: bb assets && shadow-cljs watch app acme
scripts.e2e: bb build && bb shell && shadow-cljs release e2e && npm run e2e:export && node target/e2e.js public shell && node target/e2e.js dist/site site
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.theme: clojure -M:cli theme theme/plato.tokens.edn -o public/css/plato-theme.css --json theme/plato.tokens.json --cljc src/plato/theme.cljc --sty theme/plato-beamer.sty && clojure -M:cli theme theme/acme.tokens.edn -o public/css/acme-theme.css --sty theme/acme-beamer.sty
